description: Several small bowls in light blue, mint green, and orange sit on a dark blue bedspread in front of a large pillow. The right hand slides a mint-green bowl leftward and sets it on top of a light-blue bowl, then reaches to the back, lifts a light-blue bowl and places it onto the growing stack, and finally picks up the orange bowl and sets it on top before letting go; the bowls are right-hand objects during each lift and placement.
